title: Two Regular Polygons
statementMd:
You are given two integers $n$ and $m$ ($m \lt n$). Consider a **convex** regular polygon of $n$ vertices. Recall that a regular polygon is a polygon that is equiangular (all angles are equal in measure) and equilateral (all sides have the same length).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/913025d4643bbf519a4669c05b076cda9a4dd4eb.png) Examples of convex regular polygons

Your task is to say if it is possible to build another **convex** regular polygon with $m$ vertices such that its center coincides with the center of the initial polygon and each of its vertices is some vertex of the initial polygon.

You have to answer $t$ independent test cases.

## Input

The first line of the input contains one integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$) — the number of test cases.

The next $t$ lines describe test cases. Each test case is given as two space-separated integers $n$ and $m$ ($3 \le m \lt n \le 100$) — the number of vertices in the initial polygon and the number of vertices in the polygon you want to build.

## Output

For each test case, print the answer — "`YES`" (without quotes), if it is possible to build another **convex** regular polygon with $m$ vertices such that its center coincides with the center of the initial polygon and each of its vertices is some vertex of the initial polygon and "`NO`" otherwise.

## Note

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd75d40c2cfbfd1ea85b599fb39ffa62f469d695.gif) The first test case of the example

It can be shown that the answer for the second test case of the example is "`NO`".
statementZhMd:
给定两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$m \lt n$）。考虑一个有 $n$ 个顶点的**凸**正多边形。回顾一下，正多边形是指等角（所有角的大小都相等）且等边（所有边的长度都相等）的多边形。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/913025d4643bbf519a4669c05b076cda9a4dd4eb.png) 凸正多边形示例

你的任务是判断：是否可以构造另一个有 $m$ 个顶点的**凸**正多边形，使它的中心与初始多边形的中心重合，并且它的每个顶点都是初始多边形的某个顶点。

你需要回答 $t$ 个相互独立的测试用例。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）——测试用例的数量。

接下来的 $t$ 行描述测试用例。每个测试用例包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$3 \le m \lt n \le 100$）——初始多边形的顶点数，以及你想要构造的多边形的顶点数。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，如果可以构造另一个有 $m$ 个顶点的**凸**正多边形，使其中心与初始多边形的中心重合，并且它的每个顶点都是初始多边形的某个顶点，则输出答案——`YES`（不含引号）；否则输出 `NO`。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd75d40c2cfbfd1ea85b599fb39ffa62f469d695.gif) 样例中的第一个测试用例

可以证明，样例中的第二个测试用例的答案是 `NO`。
